items.accessibility_notes: Requires vision. A non-visual accommodation must be designed before operational release.

en.stem: Look at the picture. Which option (A–D) completes the pattern in the empty cell?
en.explanation: Each row uses one shape, and the number of shapes grows by one across the row: 1, 2, then 3. The bottom row uses triangles, so the answer is 3 triangles.
en.distractor_rationale: Other options change the shape or the count.

hi.stem: चित्र देखिए। कौन-सा विकल्प (A–D) खाली खाने में पैटर्न को पूरा करता है?
hi.explanation: हर पंक्ति में एक ही आकृति है और पंक्ति में आकृतियों की संख्या 1, 2, फिर 3 होती है। निचली पंक्ति में त्रिभुज हैं, इसलिए उत्तर 3 त्रिभुज है।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: What number comes next?  3, 6, 12, 24, ?
en.explanation: Each number is double the one before, so 24 doubles to 48.
en.distractor_rationale: 30 and 36 add a constant; 60 multiplies by 2.5.

hi.explanation: हर संख्या पिछली संख्या की दुगुनी है, इसलिए 24 का दुगुना 48 है।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: What number comes next?  5, 9, 13, 17, ?
en.explanation: The numbers go up by 4 each time, so 17 + 4 = 21.
en.distractor_rationale: 20 and 22 break the constant step of 4.

hi.explanation: संख्याएँ हर बार 4 बढ़ती हैं, इसलिए 17 + 4 = 21।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Requires vision. A non-visual accommodation must be designed before operational release.

en.stem: Look at the picture. Which option (A–D) completes the pattern in the empty cell?
en.explanation: The arrow turns 90° clockwise from left to right in every row, and each row starts 90° further round. The bottom-right arrow completes a full turn and points up.
en.distractor_rationale: The other options are the other three arrow directions.

hi.stem: चित्र देखिए। कौन-सा विकल्प (A–D) खाली खाने में पैटर्न को पूरा करता है?
hi.explanation: हर पंक्ति में तीर बाएँ से दाएँ 90° घड़ी की दिशा में घूमता है और हर पंक्ति पिछली से 90° आगे शुरू होती है। निचला दायाँ तीर पूरा चक्कर लगाकर ऊपर की ओर होता है।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.explanation: Each result is the number multiplied by the next number: 2×3, 3×4, 4×5, so 5×6 = 30.
en.distractor_rationale: 25 squares the input; 28 and 36 follow other partial patterns.

hi.explanation: हर परिणाम संख्या और उसके अगले अंक का गुणनफल है: 2×3, 3×4, 4×5, इसलिए 5×6 = 30।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: What number comes next?  2, 3, 5, 8, 12, ?
en.explanation: The gaps grow by one each time (+1, +2, +3, +4), so the next gap is +5: 12 + 5 = 17.
en.distractor_rationale: 15, 16 and 18 break the growing-gap rule.

hi.explanation: अंतर हर बार एक बढ़ता है (+1, +2, +3, +4), इसलिए अगला अंतर +5 है: 12 + 5 = 17।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Requires vision. A non-visual accommodation must be designed before operational release.

en.stem: Look at the picture. Which option (A–D) completes the pattern in the empty cell?
en.explanation: Every row and every column contains a circle, a square and a triangle once each. The bottom row has a triangle and a circle, so the missing shape is a square.
en.distractor_rationale: A circle or triangle would repeat in the row or column; a diamond never appears.

hi.stem: चित्र देखिए। कौन-सा विकल्प (A–D) खाली खाने में पैटर्न को पूरा करता है?
hi.explanation: हर पंक्ति और हर स्तंभ में वृत्त, वर्ग और त्रिभुज एक-एक बार आते हैं। निचली पंक्ति में त्रिभुज और वृत्त हैं, इसलिए छूटी आकृति वर्ग है।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.explanation: Double the first number and add the second: 2×2+3 = 7, 2×4+1 = 9, so 2×5+2 = 12.
en.distractor_rationale: 10 and 11 come from partial versions of the rule; 14 doubles the second number instead.

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: What number comes next?  2, 5, 4, 10, 8, 20, 16, ?
en.explanation: Two patterns are mixed. Numbers in odd places double (2, 4, 8, 16) and numbers in even places double (5, 10, 20). The next is in an even place: 20 × 2 = 40.
en.distractor_rationale: 32 continues the odd-place pattern only.

hi.explanation: दो पैटर्न मिले हैं। विषम स्थानों की संख्याएँ दुगुनी होती हैं (2, 4, 8, 16) और सम स्थानों की भी (5, 10, 20)। अगली संख्या सम स्थान पर है: 20 × 2 = 40।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Requires vision. A non-visual accommodation must be designed before operational release.

en.stem: Look at the picture. Which option (A–D) completes the pattern in the empty cell?
en.explanation: In each row, the third picture keeps only the squares that appear in exactly one of the first two pictures. Squares that appear in both cancel out.
en.distractor_rationale: One distractor keeps every square from either picture; another keeps only shared squares; another is one square off.

hi.stem: चित्र देखिए। कौन-सा विकल्प (A–D) खाली खाने में पैटर्न को पूरा करता है?
hi.explanation: हर पंक्ति में तीसरे चित्र में केवल वे वर्ग रहते हैं जो पहले दो चित्रों में से ठीक एक में हैं। जो दोनों में हैं, वे हट जाते हैं।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: Hot is to cold as day is to ___.
en.explanation: Hot and cold are opposites; the opposite of day is night.
en.distractor_rationale: Sun, light and morning go with day rather than against it.

hi.stem: गर्म का संबंध ठंडे से है, तो दिन का संबंध ___ से है।
hi.explanation: गर्म और ठंडा विपरीत हैं; दिन का विपरीत रात है।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: Which word does NOT belong with the others?
en.explanation: Table, chair and bench are furniture; an apple is a fruit.
en.distractor_rationale: The three furniture words share a category.

hi.stem: कौन-सा शब्द बाकी से अलग है?
hi.explanation: मेज़, कुर्सी और बेंच फ़र्नीचर हैं; सेब फल है।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: Which pair has the same relationship as  Thermometer : Temperature ?
en.explanation: A thermometer is an instrument that measures temperature; a clock is an instrument that measures time.
en.distractor_rationale: The other pairs relate a tool to its material, to an unrelated object, or to a surface.

hi.stem: किस जोड़ी में वही संबंध है जो  थर्मामीटर : तापमान  में है?
hi.explanation: थर्मामीटर तापमान मापने का उपकरण है; घड़ी समय मापने का उपकरण है।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: All cats are animals. All animals need food. Which statement must be true?

options.text: Some animals do not need food.

en.explanation: Cats are animals, and animals need food, so cats need food.
en.distractor_rationale: The other statements reverse or contradict the given facts.

hi.stem: सभी बिल्लियाँ जानवर हैं। सभी जानवरों को भोजन चाहिए। कौन-सा कथन अवश्य सत्य है?

options.text: कुछ जानवरों को भोजन नहीं चाहिए।

hi.explanation: बिल्लियाँ जानवर हैं और जानवरों को भोजन चाहिए, इसलिए बिल्लियों को भोजन चाहिए।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: Choose the word that means the OPPOSITE of  scarce.
en.explanation: Scarce means hard to find or in short supply. Plentiful means there is a lot.
en.distractor_rationale: Rare is a synonym of scarce.

hi.stem: उस शब्द को चुनिए जिसका अर्थ  अल्प  का विलोम है।
hi.explanation: अल्प का अर्थ है बहुत कम। प्रचुर का अर्थ है बहुत अधिक।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: Mira is taller than Sana. Sana is taller than Tara. Rohan is shorter than Tara. Neha is taller than Sana but shorter than Mira. Who is the second tallest?
en.explanation: The order from tallest is Mira, Neha, Sana, Tara, Rohan. Neha is second.
en.distractor_rationale: Mira is tallest; Sana is third.

hi.stem: मीरा सना से लंबी है। सना तारा से लंबी है। रोहन तारा से छोटा है। नेहा सना से लंबी है पर मीरा से छोटी। दूसरी सबसे लंबी कौन है?
hi.explanation: सबसे लंबे से क्रम: मीरा, नेहा, सना, तारा, रोहन। नेहा दूसरे स्थान पर है।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: Only members can enter the club. Students are not allowed to bring a guest. Ravi entered the club and brought a guest. Which must be true?

options.text: Ravi is a member and a student.
Ravi is a member and not a student.

en.explanation: Ravi entered, so he is a member. He brought a guest, so he cannot be a student.
en.distractor_rationale: Each wrong option contradicts one of the two facts.

hi.stem: क्लब में केवल सदस्य ही प्रवेश कर सकते हैं। विद्यार्थियों को मेहमान लाने की अनुमति नहीं है। रवि क्लब में गया और मेहमान को भी ले गया। कौन-सा कथन अवश्य सत्य है?

options.text: रवि सदस्य है और विद्यार्थी भी है।
रवि सदस्य है और विद्यार्थी नहीं है।

hi.explanation: रवि क्लब में गया, इसलिए वह सदस्य है। वह मेहमान लाया, इसलिए विद्यार्थी नहीं हो सकता।

en.stem: Which option is the MIRROR IMAGE of the target shape (flipped left to right, not turned)?
en.explanation: A mirror image reverses left and right. Turned copies of the original cannot match it.
en.distractor_rationale: The other options are turned copies of the original shape.

hi.stem: कौन-सा विकल्प लक्ष्य आकृति का दर्पण-प्रतिबिंब है (बाएँ-दाएँ पलटा हुआ, घुमाया हुआ नहीं)?
hi.explanation: दर्पण-प्रतिबिंब में बायाँ-दायाँ उलट जाता है। मूल आकृति के घुमाए रूप उससे नहीं मिलते।

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Requires vision. A non-visual accommodation must be designed before operational release.

en.stem: One option shows the target shape turned (rotated) but not flipped. Which one?
en.explanation: Turning a shape never changes which way it 'leans'. The other options are mirror images, which no turn can produce.
en.distractor_rationale: Mirror images look similar but cannot be matched by turning.

hi.stem: एक विकल्प में लक्ष्य आकृति को केवल घुमाया गया है, पलटा नहीं गया है। कौन-सा?
hi.explanation: घुमाने से आकृति का रूप नहीं बदलता। बाकी विकल्प दर्पण-प्रतिबिंब हैं, जो घुमाने से नहीं बन सकते।

en.stem: Which piece exactly fills the gap in the board? Pieces may be turned but not flipped.
en.explanation: Only one piece has exactly the shape of the gap once it is turned.
en.distractor_rationale: The other pieces have the same number of squares but a different shape.

hi.stem: कौन-सा टुकड़ा बोर्ड की खाली जगह को ठीक-ठीक भरता है? टुकड़ों को घुमाया जा सकता है, पलटा नहीं जा सकता।
hi.explanation: घुमाने पर केवल एक टुकड़े का आकार खाली जगह जैसा होता है।

en.stem: Put the letters you saw in alphabetical order. Which letter is third?
en.explanation: In alphabetical order the letters are B, K, M, R, T. The third is M.
en.distractor_rationale: K, R and T are the 2nd, 4th and 5th letters.

hi.stem: आपने जो अक्षर देखे उन्हें अंग्रेज़ी वर्णमाला (A–Z) के क्रम में रखिए। तीसरा अक्षर कौन-सा है?
hi.explanation: वर्णमाला क्रम में अक्षर B, K, M, R, T हैं। तीसरा M है।

en.stem: Which pair of numbers is IDENTICAL?
en.explanation: Only 91564 — 91564 matches digit for digit.
en.distractor_rationale: The other pairs swap two neighbouring digits.

hi.stem: संख्याओं की कौन-सी जोड़ी बिल्कुल एक जैसी है?
hi.explanation: केवल 91564 — 91564 अंक-दर-अंक मेल खाती है।

en.stem: How many ▲ are in this row?   ▲ ● ▲ ■ ▲ ●
en.explanation: ▲ appears 3 times.
en.distractor_rationale: Counting slips are the usual error.

hi.explanation: ▲ 3 बार आता है।

en.stem: Which one is different?   ■ ■ ■ □ ■
en.explanation: The 4th symbol is an empty square; the rest are filled.
en.distractor_rationale: Positions 1, 3 and 5 are filled squares.

hi.stem: कौन-सा अलग है?   ■ ■ ■ □ ■
hi.explanation: चौथा चिह्न खाली वर्ग है; बाकी भरे हुए हैं।

en.stem: Use the key to turn the symbols into numbers.   ▲=1  ●=2  ■=3  ◆=4      ● ▲ ◆ ■
en.explanation: ● is 2, ▲ is 1, ◆ is 4, ■ is 3, giving 2143.
en.distractor_rationale: Distractors swap two digits.

en.stem:
In how many places do the two rows differ?
Row 1:  4 7 2 9 1 5 8 3 6 0 2 7
Row 2:  4 7 3 9 1 5 8 8 6 0 5 7
en.explanation: They differ in the 3rd, 8th and 11th places: 3 differences.
en.distractor_rationale: Missing one place or counting one extra are the usual errors.

hi.explanation: वे तीसरे, आठवें और ग्यारहवें स्थान पर अलग हैं: 3 अंतर।

en.stem: A notebook costs 12 rupees. How much do 5 notebooks cost, in rupees?
en.distractor_rationale: 17 adds instead of multiplying.

hi.stem: एक कॉपी 12 रुपये की है। 5 कॉपियों की कीमत कितने रुपये होगी?

items.author: padav-team (AI-drafted prototype; pending expert review)
items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: What number comes next?  2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
en.explanation: The gaps are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next gap is 12: 30 + 12 = 42.
en.distractor_rationale: 36, 40 and 44 do not continue the growing gaps.

items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: A pen costs 4 rupees more than a pencil. Together they cost 14 rupees. How much is the pencil, in rupees?
en.explanation: Pencil = x, pen = x + 4, so 2x + 4 = 14 and x = 5.
en.distractor_rationale: 7 is the common mistake of removing 4 only once.

hi.stem: एक पेन पेंसिल से 4 रुपये महँगा है। दोनों मिलाकर 14 रुपये के हैं। पेंसिल कितने रुपये की है?
hi.explanation: पेंसिल = x, पेन = x + 4, इसलिए 2x + 4 = 14 और x = 5।

en.explanation: 27 is 3 × 3 × 3 (3 cubed), so 4 cubed is 64.
en.distractor_rationale: 12 and 48 multiply instead of cubing; 16 squares.

en.stem: A train travels 60 km in 45 minutes. At the same speed, how far does it travel in 2 hours, in km?
en.explanation: 60 km in 45 min is 80 km per hour, so 2 hours gives 160 km.
en.distractor_rationale: 120 assumes 60 km per hour.

hi.stem: एक ट्रेन 45 मिनट में 60 किमी चलती है। उसी गति से 2 घंटे में वह कितने किमी चलेगी?
hi.explanation: 45 मिनट में 60 किमी का अर्थ है 80 किमी प्रति घंटा, इसलिए 2 घंटे में 160 किमी।

en.stem: The average of five numbers is 12. Four of them are 10, 11, 13 and 14. What is the fifth number?
en.explanation: The total must be 5 × 12 = 60. The four known numbers add to 48, so the fifth is 12.
en.distractor_rationale: Other options come from slips in the total.

hi.stem: पाँच संख्याओं का औसत 12 है। उनमें से चार संख्याएँ 10, 11, 13 और 14 हैं। पाँचवीं संख्या क्या है?
hi.explanation: कुल योग 5 × 12 = 60 होना चाहिए। चार ज्ञात संख्याओं का योग 48 है, इसलिए पाँचवीं संख्या 12 है।

items.accessibility_notes: Text only; compatible with screen readers.

en.stem: Ravi is twice as old as Meena. In 6 years the sum of their ages will be 48. How old is Meena now?
en.explanation: Meena = m, Ravi = 2m. In 6 years: (2m + 6) + (m + 6) = 48, so 3m = 36 and m = 12.
en.distractor_rationale: Other options forget to add 6 to both ages.

hi.stem: रवि की आयु मीना से दुगुनी है। 6 वर्ष बाद उनकी आयु का योग 48 होगा। मीना की आयु अभी कितनी है?

en.stem: Study the list of pairs. After it disappears: which object was paired with Karan?
en.explanation: Karan was paired with the lamp.
en.distractor_rationale: Other objects belong to other names in the list.

Anil – Umbrella
Meera – Clock
Karan – Lamp
Diya – Kite
Rohan – Bell
Neha – Cup

hi.explanation: करण के साथ दीया था।
hi.stimulus:

करण – दीया

en.explanation: Rohan was paired with the bell. The others recombine names and objects that were in the list.
en.distractor_rationale: Each wrong pair mixes a real name with a real object from a different pair.

hi.stem: इनमें से कौन-सी जोड़ी आपकी देखी हुई सूची में थी?
